name: To “Let Religion Itself Speak:” Feuerbach and Religious Consciousness in Modern Culture
headline: To “Let Religion Itself Speak:” Feuerbach and Religious Consciousness in Modern Culture
description: The article presents the author's views on philosopher Ludwig Feuerbach's opinion on religious conciousness in modern culture. Feuerbach's model of religious consciousness is explored which reportedly also demonstrates self-consciousness based on religious feeling. Other topics include the book
